profile: 湖南汉格供应链有限公司是建筑气候自动化领域的企业主体。
业务覆盖暖通材料、供应链分销、人居系统施工、智能暖通设计与高端气候技术服务。
集团以清晰边界运营七个自有品牌；产品、工艺、方案与招商细则由各品牌站点承载。
本站仅提供企业说明、业务范畴、品牌入口与商务对接通道。

about.title: Philosophy
about.sloganHeading: 智驭气候 臻享生活
about.sloganLead: 汉格的 SLOGAN 只有八个字，却定义了我们要做什么、我们要怎么做、我们要达到怎样的结果。
about.abilityTitle: 智驭气候——我们的能力与手段

ability.name: 智
ability.text:
一是智慧，是专业化，以深谙气候之道，应对千万复杂工况。
一是智能、是数字化，以智能AI的方式，借力助人达成目标。
汉格坚持用数字工具驱动专业业务——从CRM、ERP、WMS、OM到CPM、SPTS，再到HeimTherm智能设计平台。
我们相信，专业的门槛可以用技术降低，决策的质量可以用数据提升。

ability.name: 驭
ability.text:
一是驾驭、是掌控趋势，全维度多因素的综合平衡。
一是精准、是精确控制，从不可控到可信任的恒定。
建筑气候不是简单的冷暖、通风、除加湿，而是综合考量气候、光照、建筑等因素，处理焓差辐射对流背后的人体感受。
汉格的五恒智控，就是要把不可控的建筑气候变成可精确驾驭的人居环境。

ability.name: 气候
ability.text:
是我们的战场，也是我们的家园。
汉格深耕建筑环境、暖通系统及自动化控制领域，我们做的不是单一产品，而是整套建筑气候解决方案。

about.idealTitle: 臻享生活——我们的理想与归宿

ideal.name: 臻
ideal.text:
是极致、是臻选、是不妥协。
汉格代理甄选，只选有特色、有技术含量、能创造独特价值的好货；汉格原创开发，不做跟随者，做定义者。臻，是我们对品质的态度。

ideal.name: 享
ideal.text:
是从容、是脱离、是享受。
不只是享受舒适健康的室内环境，也不只是摆脱调节控制操心复杂的操作，更是享受一种从容、健康、有品质的生活方式。
我们做的一切技术、产品、系统，最终都是为了让人从被环境困扰，变为从容驾驭生活。

ideal.name: 生活
ideal.text:
不只是温度、湿度这些技术指标，更是生活方式、生活心态、生活状态、人生态度。
汉格定义自己不只是一家技术企业，我们是在为美好生活提供底层支撑——智驭气候是手段，臻享生活才是理想与归宿。

about.mission: 用智慧与技术重塑建筑气候，让每个人都能极致享受健康、舒适、可持续的美好生活。
about.vision: 成为建筑环境领域最受信赖的技术驱动型企业——以底层思维定义产品，以责任底线赢得信任，以长期导向穿越周期。
about.valuesLead: 汉格的核心价值观有三条：底层思维、责任底线、长期导向。这不是挂在墙上的口号，而是我们做每一个决策、选每一个人、谈每一次合作的标尺。

values.name: 底层思维
values.text:
汉格坚持第一性原理。无论产品还是技术，都从表象切入，层层穿透、追索到问题最根本的那一层，再由根源反推，建立从本质出发的认知。

不从众、不跟风、不迷信权威和经验。遇到问题，先问“本质是什么”，再问“怎么做”。

底层思维决定了我们不无脑跟随市场做同质化产品，而是回到问题本身，寻找真正的解。

values.name: 责任底线
values.text:
汉格相信，责任是内心的标准，不是外界给的条件，而是自己固守的底线。而真诚是坚持底线的表现。

对产品负责——做合格的产品不夸大不造假不忽悠客户，不为赚钱放弃底线，不卖对客户不好但赚钱的产品。

对人负责——不看头衔，不看资历，允许犯错，更看的是有没有底层思维、能不能责任担当、能不能长期一起干。

对合作负责——承担该承担的不推诿逃避，做好要做好的体现自身价值。敢担当，能托付，真做事。

values.name: 长期导向
values.text:
汉格关注长期。不短视、不赚快钱、不做一锤子买卖。

对产品看长期——打磨到真正好用再推向市场，不为了赶周期牺牲品质。

对人看长期——给平台、给磨砺、给成长时间，不追求短期产出，追求相互成就。

对合作看长期——诚信保底、共利共赢，做时间的朋友。

做难而正确的事，时间会给出答案。

about.practiceLead: 底层思维不是空谈，它体现在汉格做的每一件事里。

practice.name: 原创开发：从问题出发，不从市场出发
practice.text:
汉格原创式开发，始终着眼合作伙伴与市场的真实需求，而不是“市场上什么好卖就做什么”。

例如首创并命名的 F 阀——我们回到阀门在系统中的本质作用，重新定义了它的结构与功能。不做跟随者，做定义者。

practice.name: 数字化工具：用技术降低专业门槛
practice.text:
建筑气候设计是高度专业的工作，传统方式依赖工程师个人经验，效率低、误差大。

汉格自主研发 HeimTherm 建筑气候系统专业设计平台，把经验固化为算法，把直觉转化为数据。从采暖网在线采购，到小程序智能问答产品说明书，再到 HeimTherm 设计平台——汉格的数字化不是为了炫技，而是为了让专业更高效、让决策更精准。

practice.name: 五恒智控：回到人居的本质需求
practice.text:
人们对室内环境的本质需求，不是“制冷”或“制热”，而是舒适、健康、安静、洁净、富氧。

汉格的五恒系统，回到人居本质，把温度、湿度、氧气、洁净、安静作为一个整体来调控，而不是头痛医头、脚痛医脚。这就是第一性原理在产品上的落地。

about.linesLead: 汉格有明确的不做清单。这些底线和红线，比我们做什么更能定义我们是谁。

lines.name: 诚信红线
lines.text: 不造假、不夸大、不交叉承诺。说到的必须做到，做不到的绝不承诺。

lines.name: 品质红线
lines.text: 不合格的产品绝不出厂，不拿用户当试验品，不为了赶周期牺牲品质。

lines.name: 长期红线
lines.text: 不赚快钱、不做一锤子买卖、不牺牲长期价值换取短期利益。

lines.name: 合作红线
lines.text: 不越界、不抢合作方的饭碗、不做损害合作伙伴利益的事。

lines.name: 用人红线
lines.text: 不看头衔看底层思维，不看宣传看责任担当，不能长期共事的人再优秀也不勉强。

close: 同频者方能同行。汉格，与你相互成就。

items.name: 自有品牌
items.text: 严控标准，成套系统方案。
items.body:
【定位】
汉格以自有品牌覆盖材料、供应链、施工、设计与高端技术。七个品牌各自独立站点运营，总部主站只作入口与归类，不展开产品目录。
【构成】
嘉玛做暖通材料集成，蓝枫做暖通辅材集成，吾恩做亲民暖通精材，汉格做供应链与授权分销，享家无忧做标准化施工交付，HEIMTHERM 做智能暖通设计，DAS HEIM 做高端建筑气候自动化。
【边界】
主站不放置产品参数、工艺说明或方案细则。分站按定位展开，彼此不重复同一套落地内容。来访者先看清边界，再进入对应站点。

items.name: 代理甄选
items.text: 臻选行业特色品牌，独特价值赋能渠道伙伴。
items.body:
【定位】
代理甄选是集团对外的分销端口。授权代理与渠道选品归口汉格，不由材料、施工或设计品牌各自对外招商。
【原则】
汉格不按“什么好卖代理什么”铺货。甄选看特色、技术含量、能否创造独特价值。渠道时代先后引入曼瑞德、保利、绿羽、欧博诺、胡赫、沃茨等品牌，授权关系由汉格分站说明。
【边界】
主站品牌矩阵只列甄选名单，不展开产品、参数或招商细则。对外分销、授权与集采的端口归口汉格，避免与自有品牌站点交叉承诺。

items.name: 集成仓配
items.text: 集中采购仓储成套供货，降本增效交付可控。
items.body:
【定位】
汉格作为供应链主体，把集采、仓储与工程成套供货收在同一条链上：按工程需求组套，而不是按单品零售铺货。
【落点】
仓库设在长沙开福区传化公路港，服务渠道与工程项目的出货节奏。材料按设计与施工界面组套发出，减少现场临时拼货。
【边界】
主站不放置库存、报价或物流细则。仓配执行、授权分销与集采条款在汉格分站说明。现场收货与安装分别对接享家无忧，仓配不越界承担施工。

items.name: 落地安装
items.text: 标准化施工与管理交付，保障项目落地品质。
items.body:
【定位】
落地安装是把设计与材料变成可验收的现场。享家无忧只做标准化施工与交付：样板级工地、管家式服务。
【协同】
设计由 HEIMTHERM 或 DAS HEIM 输出，材料由自有品牌展示、汉格集采，施工由享家无忧交付。界面清楚，是为了不交叉承诺。
【边界】
享家无忧不销售产品，不出具方案。主站不放置工法、验收表或施工案例。现场细则在享家无忧站点上线后展开。

items.name: 智能设计
items.text: 数字化驱动设计，输出精准专业的系统方案。
items.body:
【定位】
建筑气候设计高度依赖专业判断。HEIMTHERM 把负荷计算、专业选型、仿真模拟做成可交付的设计服务，并以自有开发的建筑气候系统专业设计平台降低经验门槛。
【协同】
方案交给供应链与施工执行：材料对接汉格与各材料品牌，安装对接享家无忧。数字化工具服务设计本身，不替代现场。
【边界】
HEIMTHERM 不施工、不卖货。主站不放置设计案例或软件操作说明，细则在 HEIMTHERM 站点。

items.name: 五恒智控
items.text: 五恒系统智能调控，打造恒温恒湿恒氧气候。
items.body:
【定位】
人对室内环境的本质需求不是制冷或制热，而是舒适、健康、安静、洁净、富氧。五恒智控把温度、湿度、氧气、洁净、安静作为一个整体来调控。
【承担】
DAS HEIM 做高端建筑气候自动化的技术定制与研发，不替代供应链，也不替代施工。材料归口汉格，安装归口享家无忧。
【边界】
主站只说明定位与协同，不展开产品参数、控制系统清单或案例。站点上线前，对外问询走总部通道。

eras.name: 零售时代
eras.text:
2008 年南方冰灾，汉格由此起源。
创始人温辉时任职于美的集团。冰灾令其痛感采暖技术匮乏，
十年职场亦深憾疏于陪伴家人、未曾安顿人生。
遂辞职归乡，于长沙开设首家暖通门店。

eras.name: 渠道时代
eras.text:
2012后年渠道市场兴起，恰逢长沙地铁建设，汉格三家零售门店均被施工围挡。
汉格借势退出零售，不与分销商争利，全面聚焦渠道批发，
前后甄选代理了曼瑞德、保利、绿羽、欧博诺、胡赫、沃茨等一系列品牌 。

eras.name: 供应链时代
eras.text:
2020 年新冠疫情后，汉格有感于部分行业品牌格局狭隘、短视逐利、品质下滑，
亦见中国制造不乏高品质工厂，产品不输欧美，唯缺挖掘和赋能，
于是启动供应链转型，**通过代工生产、集中采购、合资共建等方式，
陆续推出了嘉玛、蓝枫、托米雷克、格林豪斯、吾恩等行业品牌。

eras.name: 生态时代
eras.text:
2026 年地产家装下行与经济调整双重叠加，行业普遍承压。

汉格整合多年技术沉淀，结合智能 AI数字化技术，

推出 HEIMTHERM 系列专业软件与 DAS HEIM 高端气候系统。

将专业能力平台化，赋能合作伙伴更专业地服务客户、涉足此前力不能及的高端技术领域。

eras.name: 未来···
eras.text:
千里之行，始于足下。
从一家小门店到一个生态平台，从考虑自家采暖到致力千万家舒适，
从安顿自己人生到倡导臻享生活的人生态度，汉格走了十八年。

面向未来，汉格仍将坚持底层思维、责任底线、长期导向，
以技术赋能伙伴、以系统定义品质，在 "智驭气候，臻享生活" 的路上稳步前行。

profile: Hunan Hange Supply Chain Co., Ltd. is the corporate entity of the group in building climate automation.
The group covers HVAC materials, supply-chain distribution, residential system installation, intelligent HVAC design, and high-end climate technology services.
Seven owned brands operate with defined boundaries. Product, process, scheme, and distribution detail live on each brand site.
This headquarters site provides company information, business scope, brand entry points, and a channel for commercial inquiry.

about.title: Philosophy
about.sloganHeading: Master the climate. Live it fully.
about.sloganLead: Eight characters in Chinese. They state who we are, and why the work exists.
about.abilityTitle: Master the climate — capability and method

ability.name: Wisdom
ability.text: Intelligence, and digital tools. Hange runs the work on systems: online heating procurement, a mini-program that answers product questions, and HeimTherm, the in-house building-climate design platform. Expertise should be easier to use. Decisions should rest on data.

ability.name: Mastery
ability.text: Control, and precise regulation. Building climate is not merely hot or cold. It is a balance of temperature, humidity, oxygen, cleanliness, and quiet. Five-constant climate control turns weather that cannot be managed into an interior that can.

ability.name: Climate
ability.text: This is the field. Hange works in building environment and HVAC. The offering is not a single product, but a complete building-climate solution.

ideal.name: Refinement
ideal.text: The extreme, the selected, the uncompromised. Agency selection takes goods with character, technical substance, and a distinct value. Original development does not follow; it defines. That is the stance on quality.

ideal.name: Ease
ideal.text: Not only a comfortable room, but a way of living that is calm, healthy, and considered. Every technique, product, and system is there so people stop being troubled by the environment and start governing daily life.

ideal.name: Life
ideal.text: Not only temperature and humidity as metrics, but a way of living, a temperament, a condition, an attitude. Hange is not only an HVAC firm. It supplies the substrate of a better life. Mastering climate is the means. Living it fully is the end.

about.mission: Reshape building climate with intelligence and technique, so that health, comfort, and a sustainable life are available without compromise.
about.vision: To be the most trusted technology-driven firm in the building-environment field — products defined from first principles, trust earned at the line of responsibility, and a long horizon through the cycle.
about.valuesLead: Three values: first principles, a line of responsibility, and a long horizon. They are not wall slogans. They are the measure for every decision, every hire, and every partnership.

values.name: First principles
values.text:
Hange starts from first principles. Product or technique, the work cuts through appearance until it reaches the root of the problem, then builds understanding back from that root.

Not crowd-following, not fashion, not inherited habit treated as law. First: what is the essence. Then: what to do.

That is why the firm does not add another copy of what the market already sells. It returns to the problem and looks for a real answer.

values.name: A line of responsibility
values.text:
Honesty is the cheapest form of communication, and the highest barrier to entry.

On product: nothing unfit leaves the plant. No inflation, no fabrication, no treating users as a trial.

On people: not by title, not by publicity. First principles, responsibility, and whether the work can be done together over time.

On partners: no overreach, no short horizon, no overlapping promises. No taking a partner’s work. No one-off deals.

values.name: A long horizon
values.text:
Hange looks far. No short view, no easy money, no one-off deals.

On product: finish until it is truly usable, then release. Quality is not traded for a calendar.

On people: a platform, a grind, and time to grow. Not a hunt for output this quarter. Mutual accomplishment.

On partners: honesty as the floor, shared gain, time as an ally.

Do the hard and correct thing. Time answers.

about.practiceLead: First principles are not a speech. They show up in the work.

practice.name: Original development: from the problem, not the market
practice.text:
Original development starts from what partners and the market actually need — not from whatever happens to sell.

The F-valve, named here first, is an example: return to what a valve must do in the system, then redefine structure and function. Not a follower. A definer.

practice.name: Digital tools: lower the bar of expertise
practice.text:
Building-climate design is specialized work. The old way leans on one engineer’s experience: slow, and easy to miss.

HeimTherm, the in-house professional design platform, turns experience into algorithms and intuition into data. From online heating procurement, to a mini-program that reads the product manual, to HeimTherm itself — the digital work is not display. It makes expertise faster and decisions more exact.

practice.name: Five-constant climate: back to what a room is for
practice.text:
What people need indoors is not “cooling” or “heating”. It is comfort, health, quiet, cleanliness, and oxygen.

The five-constant system treats temperature, humidity, oxygen, cleanliness, and quiet as one regulation — not a patch for each complaint. That is first principles in the product.

about.linesLead: There is a clear list of what Hange will not do. The lines define the firm as much as the work does.

lines.name: Honesty
lines.text: No fabrication, no inflation, no overlapping promises. What is said is done. What cannot be done is not promised.

lines.name: Quality
lines.text: Nothing unfit leaves the plant. Users are not a trial. Quality is not traded for a calendar.

lines.name: Duration
lines.text: No easy money, no one-off deals, no long-term value sold for a short gain.

lines.name: Partnership
lines.text: No overreach, no taking a partner’s work, no harm to a partner’s interest.

lines.name: People
lines.text: First principles over titles, responsibility over publicity. Talent that cannot work over time is not forced in.

about.storiesLead: Culture is not written. It is done. It sits in each decision, each product, and each partnership.
close: Master the climate. Live it fully.
Those on the same frequency can walk together. Hange, and mutual accomplishment.

business.title: Business
business.lead: A top-level classification of the group’s fields. Open an entry for boundaries and how the tracks work together. Products, processes, schemes, and terms are published on the brand sites.

items.name: Own brands
items.text: Seven owned brands. Product and range detail live on each brand site.
items.body:
【Position】
Owned brands cover materials, supply chain, installation, design, and high-end technology. Each brand runs its own site. This headquarters site is an entry and a map of boundaries, not a product catalogue.
【The seven】
GARMA integrates HVAC materials. Bluemaple integrates auxiliary HVAC materials. Wuen supplies accessible HVAC goods. HANGE handles supply chain and authorized distribution. Sunjoy carries standardized installation. HEIMTHERM provides intelligent HVAC design. DAS HEIM develops high-end building climate automation.
【Boundary】
This site does not publish product data, process notes, or scheme detail. Each brand site develops its own field without repeating the same operating content. Visitors see the boundary first, then enter the matching site.

items.name: Agency selection
items.text: Authorized agency and channel selection are handled by HANGE.
items.body:
【Position】
Agency selection is the group’s external distribution port. Authorized agency and channel goods are handled by HANGE — not by the material, installation, or design brands recruiting on their own.
【Principle】
Hange does not agency whatever happens to sell. Selection looks for character, technical substance, and a distinct value. In the channel years the list came to include MANNRED, POLY, LVYU, OBERNO, HUCH, and WATTS. Authorization is described on the HANGE site.
【Boundary】
The brand matrix on this site lists names only. No product data, no terms of trade. Distribution, authorization, and procurement stay with HANGE, so promises do not overlap the owned-brand sites.

items.name: Integrated warehousing
items.text: Procurement, warehousing, and project supply are handled by HANGE.
items.body:
【Position】
As the supply-chain entity, HANGE holds procurement, warehousing, and project kitting on one line: goods are assembled for the job, not laid out as retail singles.
【Place】
The warehouse sits at Transfar Highway Port in Kaifu District, Changsha, serving channel and project dispatch. Materials leave as kits matched to design and installation interfaces, so the site is not left to improvise stock.
【Boundary】
This site does not publish inventory, quotations, or logistics rules. Execution, authorized distribution, and procurement terms live on the HANGE site. Receiving and installation stay with Sunjoy. Warehousing does not take on the site work.

items.name: On-site installation
items.text: Standardized installation and handover are carried by Sunjoy.
items.body:
【Position】
Installation turns design and materials into a site that can be handed over. Sunjoy does only standardized installation and handover — a model site, a steward’s service.
【Together】
Design comes from HEIMTHERM or DAS HEIM. Materials are shown by owned brands and procured by HANGE. Installation is carried by Sunjoy. Clear interfaces keep promises from overlapping.
【Boundary】
Sunjoy does not sell products or issue schemes. This site does not publish methods, checklists, or installation cases. Site detail will live on the Sunjoy site when it opens.

items.name: Intelligent design
items.text: Schemes and digital design are carried by HEIMTHERM.
items.body:
【Position】
Building-climate design depends on professional judgment. HEIMTHERM turns load calculation, selection, and simulation into a deliverable design service, and uses an in-house professional platform to lower the bar of experience.
【Together】
The scheme is executed by supply chain and installation: materials go to HANGE and the material brands, installation to Sunjoy. Digital tools serve the design. They do not replace the site.
【Boundary】
HEIMTHERM does not install or sell. This site does not publish design cases or software manuals. Operating detail lives on the HEIMTHERM site.

items.name: Five-constant climate
items.text: High-end building climate automation is carried by DAS HEIM.
items.body:
【Position】
What a room needs is not cooling or heating as such. It is comfort, health, quiet, cleanliness, and oxygen. Five-constant climate control regulates temperature, humidity, oxygen, cleanliness, and quiet as one.
【Role】
DAS HEIM develops high-end building climate automation. It does not replace the supply chain or the installer. Materials stay with HANGE. Installation stays with Sunjoy.
【Boundary】
This site states position and collaboration only. No product data, no control-system lists, no cases. Until the brand site opens, outside inquiry goes through headquarters.

history.title: History
history.lead: The stages Hange has walked. Eras on the left; key nodes along a timeline on the right.

eras.name: Retail era
eras.text: It began in retail: facing daily demand in the shop, making goods and service something you could see and check.

eras.name: Channel era
eras.text: Steady supply moved into the dealer network. Reliability of delivery came before a one-off push of goods.

eras.name: Supply-chain era
eras.text: A supply-chain entity took procurement, warehousing, and kit supply as one, so each brand kept a clear role on the same chain.

eras.name: Platform era
eras.text: Digital tools and the brand matrix turned expertise into a reusable platform: less repeated labour, more exact decisions.

eras.name: Future
eras.text: Return to the problem. Not another copy of what the market already sells. Do the hard and correct thing, and let time shape the next form.

events.text: Retail points opened; supply faced the user directly.
The dealer network took shape, with steady delivery first.
The supply-chain entity began to run procurement, warehousing, and kits.
Brand matrix and digital tools in parallel; expertise began to platform.
The next stage: products from first principles, partnerships over the long horizon.

jobs.title: 五恒系统技术员
jobs.team: 达斯海姆建筑气候研究所
jobs.location: 长沙市天心区海伦堡·爱ME城市11栋
jobs.summary:
**岗位职责**

1. 负责五恒系统（恒温、恒湿、恒氧、恒静、恒洁）项目的现场安装、调试与交付运行；
2. 负责热泵主机（地源 / 空气源）、辐射空调末端、新风除湿、加湿净化等设备的安装、
    联动调试与系统平衡；
3. 负责系统的日常运行维护、故障诊断与售后维修，快速响应并闭环处理客户报修；
4. 配合设计部门完成设备选型、管路走向的现场核对与施工交底；
5. 参与项目验收，编写安装调试记录、运行数据与运维档案。

**任职要求**

1. 暖通、制冷、机电、电气等相关专业，中专及以上学历；
2. 1 年以上中央空调、新风、地暖、除湿或水系统安装调试经验，
   有辐射空调 / 五恒系统经验者优先；
3. 能看懂系统图、水电施工图，熟练使用压力表、万用表等常用检测工具；
4. 持有制冷与空调作业证、电工证、焊工证者优先；
5. 动手能力强、责任心强，能适应工地环境和短期出差；
6. 会 CAD 出图、懂负荷计算者加分。
